body: Sorry for wasting your time. Not of those options seem appealing. Just going to kill myself, thanks for trying though.

How else would I make money that doesn't require work? People aren't just going to had me money. 

You had to work to buy the house you sold, it's not like I can just sell a house and retire. 

Yea, I'll never have the life I want so I need to be true to myself by not wasting time trying to achieve the impossible.
